thread:
Alex Kim: Heads up — nightly loadtest showed ~20% p99 tail latency regression on H100 replay (2048 tokens) vs last week. Wondering if this is kernel selector or env drift.
Maya Patel: I saw that too. Regression only on H100 nodes; A100 farms are stable. Selector logs show it picked matmul_v2_fast on the H100 runs. cc @Jin Park
Sam Rivera: I merged a batching heuristic tweak earlier today. Could be related. Which driver/CUDA are the failing boxes on?
Alex Kim: H100 boxes: driver 535.113.01 / CUDA 12.2. A100 boxes: driver 525.105.17 / CUDA 11.8. Docker image used: redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03-15. Kernel flags: FLASH_ATTENTION=1 KERNEL_OPT=aggressive.
Jin Park: I pulled the replay artifacts and nvprof traces. We're seeing more L2 spills + many small kernel launches. KV cache prefetch rate also spiked which messes up batch packing. I uploaded traces to the perf run.
Maya Patel: grep of selector log snippet: `grep "selected_kernel" /var/log/runtime/selector.log | tail -n 20` shows repeated matmul_v2_fast choices on H100.
Sam Rivera: If the batching heuristic packs differently with higher prefetch, we can end up with awkward occupancy for the chosen kernel. Suspect selector ranking change + KERNEL_OPT flags. Can we force legacy kernel to confirm?
perf-bot: Automated: nightly-1999991234 loadtest attached -> https://perf.redwood/reports/1999991234. Collected artifacts: pprof, nvprof, selector-debug, replay-harness logs.
Alex Kim: Plan: 1) Run isolated replay harness on H100 with prod image but KERNEL_OPT=conservative, force legacy kernel. 2) Run synthetic generator matching seq-length distribution to verify synthetic vs replay differences. 3) Collect selector-debug and pprof. Who can run step 1?
Jin Park: Running now on h100-staging-7. Command: `./replay-run --job-id 1999991234 --image redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03-15 --env KERNEL_OPT=conservative --force-kernel=legacy`
Maya Patel: Also: we should add CI matrix entry pinned to driver 535.113.01 + image tag so this gets caught earlier. Add kernel flag checksum to test metadata too.
Sam Rivera: I'll open a revert PR for the batching tweak and add a canary perf job. :thumbsup:
Jin Park: Preliminary: forcing legacy kernel reduces p99 by ~18% and L2 spill metric down ~30%. Looks like selector mis-ranked preference under the new flags on Hopper. Uploading selector debug dump now.
Alex Kim: Nice repro. Next steps: add assertion to nightly diff to record driver/CUDA in run metadata, store kernel flag checksum, and include selected kernel in perf regression emails.
Maya Patel: I'll draft a short RFC for 'loadtest-environment-checksum' and CI assertions, assign to eng-runtime.
Sam Rivera: Queueing PRs: revert batching heuristic + CI matrix change. ETA: EOD.
perf-bot: Summary: probable root cause = kernel selector ranking interacting with KERNEL_OPT flags + Hopper driver differences. Mitigation = force legacy kernel in prod canary, revert batching tweak until selector fix, add CI matrix and env checksum. Links: replay logs, selector debug, perf pprof.
